question: Does the explicit C^6 representation already contain a canonical projection descending to q=p_I+p_P?

targetLift.targetProjection: q=p_I+p_P on the five-role coefficient space

sixteenStateMultiplicityRepair.jointRepresentedOppositeAlgebra: direct sum of scalar identities on the twelve joint sector-type blocks
sixteenStateMultiplicityRepair.naturality: UNSAT under U(2) multiplicity-basis changes without a chosen ray

pathAndJordanAlgebras.JordanSelfAdjointPart: Hermitian part of the same two full component algebras
pathAndJordanAlgebras.center: C times sheet-plus identity direct-sum C times sheet-minus identity
pathAndJordanAlgebras.interpretation: connected paths generate Q as a noncentral projection along with every other subspace projection; they do not single it out

sourceAndUniqueness.physicalMeaningRequiresCorrespondence: identifying PN,IN with target I,P and choosing their two J-orbits is exactly the descent dictionary
sourceAndUniqueness.verdict: Q_anchor exists algebraically after both left and right sector projectors are admitted, but q as the physical selected-return projection appears only after the correspondence is assumed

adjoiningAudit.multiplicityOneJointAlgebra: no change because Q_anchor is already present
adjoiningAudit.multiplicityOneRepresentedAlgebra: enlarges C^6 image to 8 blocks on H12 and 9 blocks on the H16 sector repair
adjoiningAudit.commutantEffect: shrinks represented commutant dimension 30 to 22 on H12 and 46 to 32 on the H16 sector repair
adjoiningAudit.multiplicityRepair: rank-one Q enlarges the represented image and breaks the U(2) multiplicity commutant; dimension falls 54 to 38
adjoiningAudit.gaugeEffectIfPromotedToAlgebraElement: adds two abelian block directions on H12 and three on either H16 repair before unimodularity/kernel constraints
adjoiningAudit.commutatorInterpretation: only the already allowed P--N chain edge crosses the selected corner boundary
adjoiningAudit.newSupportUnderInnerFluctuation: none at primitive level because [D,Q] is supported on existing D edges
adjoiningAudit.remainingRisk: quadratic path products still require the selected-return expectation to suppress open length-two leakage

decision.strongestConclusion: the desired lift is an available but nonminimal sector sum in multiplicity-one models and a genuinely new rank-one commutant projection in the multiplicity repair; its physical interpretation is not sourced before the correspondence dictionary

boundary: The lattice counts concern projections in the represented C^6 image, opposite image, their generated joint diagonal algebra, and the full path/Jordan algebras of the explicit supports. They do not exclude a larger sourced algebra whose center contains Q_anchor, but no such algebra appears in the current corpus.
